def: properly, a (peremptory) terminus, i.e. (by implication) duration, in the sense of advance or perpetuity (substantially as a noun, either with or without a preposition)
kjv: eternity, ever(-lasting, -more), old, perpetually, [phrase] world without end.

occurrences.text: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the Lord searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.
Knowest thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth,
The Lord is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.
The fear of the Lord is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the Lord are true and righteous altogether.
For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.
Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.
For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.
So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:
His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.
He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.
The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.

For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
Trust ye in the Lord for ever: for in the Lord Jehovah is everlasting strength:
Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever:

For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.
Be not wroth very sore, O Lord, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech thee, we are all thy people.
But be ye glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create: for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.

Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he did pursue his brother with the sword, and did cast off all pity, and his anger did tear perpetually, and he kept his wrath for ever:
Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.
He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations; and the everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways are everlasting.
